errors.text_span: The horizontal axis represents different models and methods, including Baseline, Fast-Solving Prompt, SFT, DPO, and O1-Pruner... The vertical axis represents Inference Time (minute)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the horizontal and vertical axes. The horizontal axis represents 'Inference Time (minute)', while the vertical axis represents the different methods/categories.
The description fails to mention the individual titles of the two charts, 'Marco-o1-7B' and 'QwQ-32B-Preview'. It only refers to them as 'the left chart' and 'the right chart'.
The categories on the y-axis (Baseline, Fast-Solving Prompt, SFT, DPO, O1-Pruner) are not arranged in alphabetical order.
The description incorrectly identifies the color for the 'O1-Pruner' category as purple, when it is clearly blue in the chart and legend.
The description repeatedly uses the term 'height' to describe the length of the bars in a horizontal bar chart. The correct term would be 'length' or 'value'.

errors.text_span: the SFT bar (orange) extends to approximately 2, the DPO bar (gray) is around 1
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the colors for the SFT and DPO categories. In the chart, SFT is gray and DPO is orange.

errors.text_span: The Baseline bar (green) has an approximate height of 0.5, the Fast-Solving Prompt bar (yellow) reaches roughly 1.5, the SFT bar (orange) extends to approximately 2, the DPO bar (gray) is around 1, and the O1-Pruner bar (purple) has a height of approximately 2.5.
errors.evidence: All numerical values reported for the left chart ('Marco-o1-7B') are incorrect. The actual approximate values are: Baseline ~2.2, Fast-Solving Prompt ~2.1, SFT ~2.1, DPO ~1.4, and O1-Pruner ~1.1.

errors.text_span: Baseline (green) is approximately 1, Fast-Solving Prompt (yellow) reaches roughly 3, SFT (orange) extends to approximately 4, DPO (gray) is around 2, and O1-Pruner (purple) has a height of approximately 6.
errors.evidence: All numerical values reported for the right chart ('QwQ-32B-Preview') are incorrect. The actual approximate values are: Baseline ~6.3, Fast-Solving Prompt ~5.2, SFT ~5.9, DPO ~5.8, and O1-Pruner ~4.0.
The description of the x-axis tick marks is incomplete for both charts. For the left chart, it omits the tick labels for 0 and 2.5. For the right chart, it omits the tick label for 7.
